# Tom Devonshire

> Software engineer based in Auckland, New Zealand. BE(Hons) Software Engineering,
> First Class Honours, University of Auckland. Full-stack work across C#/ASP.NET,
> React, React Native, Java/Spring Boot and Node/Express.

This is the personal portfolio and CV of Tom Devonshire. Contact: tom@devonshire.co.nz

## Experience

- [Hoist NZ](https://hoist.nz/): Junior Developer, 05/2026 - present. Builds full-stack solutions in C# and ASP.NET with React and React Native, working across design, architecture, build, testing and support.
- [Svasthya NZ](https://svasthya.nz/): Software Engineering Intern, 01/2025 - 10/2025. Built and deployed a cross-platform Point of Sale app in React Native with a Node/Express and MySQL backend, integrating Stripe's Terminal SDK to replace a third-party solution and cut transaction fees by 28%.
- [New Zealand Physics and Math Competition](https://www.nzpmc.com/): Undergraduate Software Trainee, 01/2024 - 01/2025. Built a full-stack competition platform with a React frontend and MongoDB, then migrated the backend from Node/Express to Spring Boot to match the production stack.
- [Steel & Tube](https://steelandtube.co.nz/): Production and Manufacturing Engineering Intern, 11/2023 - 03/2024. Built a SCORM-compliant e-learning module reporting quiz results to the Intelex training platform.

## Projects

- [Figaro - Spatial Visualisation Testing Framework](https://devonshire.co.nz/#projects): University of Auckland research project, 2025. Procedural question generation in FreeCAD; evaluated 15,840 responses across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Mistral models with shuffled answer positions; analysed in R with logistic regression and ANOVA, benchmarked against 988 students.
- [Path.io](https://devonshire.co.nz/#projects): DEVS x GDSC hackathon, 2023. Gamified fitness Android app in Java where players walk to enclose territory. Third place overall and Most Promising Concept.

## Education

- [The University of Auckland](https://www.auckland.ac.nz/): Bachelor of Engineering (Honours), Software Engineering, 02/2022 - 03/2026. First Class Honours, cumulative GPA 7.6.
- [Sancta Maria College, Auckland](https://www.sanctamaria.school.nz/): NCEA Levels 1, 2 and 3, each endorsed with Excellence. Top scholar in Calculus and Digital Technologies at Level 3.
